say:1:1460430001:1.text: Mr. Alando! How have you been lately?
say:1:1460430001:1.source_cn: 阿兰多先生！最近过得怎么样？

say:2:1460430002:1.text: Never better, Xera. I'm truly grateful for this job you've given me.
say:2:1460430002:1.source_cn: 比什么都好，席蕾小姐，你可真是给我找了份好工作。

say:3:1460430003:1.text: I was utterly distraught when Lord Ravion dismissed me from the royal court, and you pulled me out of that bind by asking me to maintain this garden!
say:3:1460430003:1.source_cn: 沙利叶殿下让我不用继续照顾王庭的花园时，我可难受了好些...

say:4:1460430004:1.text: Look, I've cleared out all the weeds here and planted some herbs you might be able to use.
say:4:1460430004:1.source_cn: 看，这一带原本长了杂草的地，我已经清出来了，新种了一些...

choice_prompt:5:1460430004.text: Look, I've cleared out all the weeds here and planted some herbs you might be able to use.
choice_prompt:5:1460430004.source_cn: 看，这一带原本长了杂草的地，我已经清出来了，新种了一些你们可能用得上的药材。

say:6:1460430005:1.text: Here they are! We also have rock mushrooms. How great is that? All the mushrooms are over here.
say:6:1460430005:1.source_cn: 梦想伞菇？有，当然，还有坚韧石菇，蘑菇类的我都种在这边了。
say:6:1460430005:1.male: Here they are! We also have rock mushrooms. How great is that? All the mushrooms are over here.
say:6:1460430005:1.female: Here they are! We also have rock mushrooms. How great is that? All the mushrooms are over here.

say:7:1460430006:1.text: I'll plant more if you need them!
say:7:1460430006:1.source_cn: 你看着用得上，我这些日子就再多种一些！
say:7:1460430006:1.male: I'll plant more if you need them!
say:7:1460430006:1.female: I'll plant more if you need them!

choice_prompt:8:1460430006.text: I'll plant more if you need them!
choice_prompt:8:1460430006.source_cn: 你看着用得上，我这些日子就再多种一些！
choice_prompt:8:1460430006.male: I'll plant more if you need them!
choice_prompt:8:1460430006.female: I'll plant more if you need them!

say:9:1460430007:1.text: Great! Let's gather the mushrooms and head back to the clinic.
say:9:1460430007:1.source_cn: 好极了，那我们收集好，就快点回医馆那边吧。
say:9:1460430007:1.male: Great! Let's gather the mushrooms and head back to the clinic.
say:9:1460430007:1.female: Great! Let's gather the mushrooms and head back to the clinic.

say:10:1460430008:1.text: Ravion's a changed man now! We can't let him get ahead of us!
say:10:1460430008:1.source_cn: 如今沙利叶不磨磨蹭蹭的，手脚可是快得很，别让他比下去了！
say:10:1460430008:1.male: Ravion's a changed man now! We can't let him get ahead of us!
say:10:1460430008:1.female: Ravion's a changed man now! We can't let him get ahead of us!

choice:8:0:1.text: I need them for my potions.
choice:8:0:1.male: I need them for my potions.
choice:8:0:1.female: I need them for my potions.
